snippets.BUTTON_UPGRADE_BOLLY: Upgrade - extends Heart Radius and Heart Throw Frequency
snippets.PD_BUTTON_BOLLY_TOOLTIP: Bolly - will hit individual monsters - price: 10 Coins
snippets.PD_BUTTON_POKOPET_TOOLTIP: Pokopet - will slow down monster movements - price: 15 Coins
snippets.PD_BUTTON_WOOBY_TOOLTIP: Wooby - will hit multiple monsters at the same time - price: 20 Coins
snippets.PD_HINT_01: Sometimes it is better to upgrade the abilities of your existing towers instead of buying new ones.
snippets.PD_HINT_02: Try to spend as little Coins as possible within a level. They will come in handy in later levels.
snippets.PD_HINT_03: Think good and hard about where you place your towers, in order to cover the biggest possible distance
snippets.PD_HINT_04: Always try to combine your towers to increase their effectiveness
snippets.PD_LOST_RESTART: Do you want to restart the level or exit the game?
snippets.PD_POPUP_LOST: Unfortunately you have no heart energy left.
snippets.PD_POPUP_NEXT_LEVEL: You have reached the next level
snippets.PD_SCREEN_HELP_TEXT_01: There are three different types of defence towers: Bolly, Wooby and Pokopet. Click the corresponding button to purchase one of them.
snippets.PD_SCREEN_HELP_TEXT_02: Using your cursor, place your tower on an empty space
snippets.PD_SCREEN_HELP_TEXT_03: Evron's evil creatures from Bitterland appear through the red portal and are trying to reach Panfu
snippets.PD_SCREEN_HELP_TEXT_04: Place your towers within the reach of the creatures in order to defeat them with Magic Hearts. You will receive a Coin for every creature that was hit by a Heart and disappeared
snippets.PD_SCREEN_HELP_TEXT_05: Press the Upgrade Button underneath a tower to increase its ability. The price rises with each new upgrade.
snippets.PD_SCREEN_HELP_TEXT_06: Careful: with every creature that reaches the green portal, your Heart Energy will decrease. Once your energy has gone down to zero, you have lost the game.
snippets.PD_SCREEN_PLAYTHROUGH: You did it, all of the evil creatures have been defeated. Panfu has been saved!!!
snippets.PD_WOOBY_TOOLTIP_ABIL: will hit multiple monsters at the same time
